purpose: Machine-readable check table for the xai-consistency-audit skill. Defines the 3 check groups that keep real development aligned with the management surface: (1) the 3-surface boundary (Web/App/Plugin 越界/归属), (2) feature reconciliation across code/PRD/dashboard, (3) skill/workflow registration + snapshot freshness. The audit DETECTS (read-only) then, on confirmation, applies record-drift fixes to BOTH docs and the dashboard so they never diverge. Code violations are report-only; governed fields (priority/branch/release/ship) are needs-operator.

hard_rules: DETECT is always read-only; never write during scanning
APPLY only after explicit operator confirmation; record-drift fixes write docs + dashboard in ONE coherent pass so they stay aligned
CODE violations (a plugin implementing native commands, re-doing a Web module, bypassing D3) are REPORT-ONLY — fixing code is feature-workflow territory, not this skill
NEVER auto-change priority / branch / release / ship / roadmap — report needs-operator (dev-dashboard.md write-authority)
frozen lines (plugin/sync PAUSED, site/admin PROPOSED) get impact-note only, no source landing

this skill detects + routes; it delegates real writes to owning skills where one exists (dashboard via xai-dev-dashboard-sync rules, PRD via xai-feature-dossier-sync, syncScope proof via xai-account-sync-scope-check)

frozen_lines.plugin: P2 PAUSED until G1 — impact-note only
frozen_lines.sync: P2 PAUSED until G1 — receipt only

check_groups.title: ① 边界 越界/归属 (3-surface table HR1-5)
check_groups.summary: Every feature/package must sit on the correct surface (Web/App/Plugin) and obey the MODULE_BOUNDARIES capability table. Reuses module-classification.json drift_checks + completes HR1/HR2/HR5.

checks.detect: a plugin package defines/implements a native window·file·clipboard Tauri command (window.rs-style) instead of consuming one
a plugin re-implements the web-form of a module already covered by Web (tasks/board/calendar/pomodoro/habits/statistics...) instead of sharing the business-logic package
a plugin entity has no syncScope, or a device-local entity is reachable by the outbox
a feature named pet/widgets/grid/dashboard is not disambiguated web-DOM vs desktop-native
a Web change reached the App/dev line without a D3 parity receipt
a packages/* path cited in docs/dashboard does not exist on disk (e.g. plugin-meditation, plugin-settings)
source landed on a PAUSED/PROPOSED line without an operator unfreeze
a feature matches no module signal, or 2+ with equal weight

check_groups.title: ② Feature ↔ 代码 / PRD / 看板 对账 (blind spot A)
check_groups.summary: Keep the feature picture honest across packages (code), PRD/PLUGIN_MAP (spec/status), and dashboard features[] (view). No ghost features, no missing features, no stale status.

checks.detect: a dashboard feature has NO PRD section AND NO package backing it
a package/feature on disk (or a dev_log marked SHIPPED) has no corresponding dashboard feature and/or no PRD entry
dashboard feature status disagrees with PLUGIN_MAP status or dev_log status (e.g. package exists but dashboard says proposed; dev_log SHIPPED but dashboard in-dev)
the same feature is described with conflicting surface/status across MODULE_BOUNDARIES, dashboard, and PLUGIN_MAP
checks.owning_fix: self (reconcile all three in one pass)

checks.detect: code/dev_log iterations with no matching PRD requirement, or PRD requirements with no code

check_groups.title: ③ Skill/Workflow 登记 + 快照新鲜度 (blind spot B+C)
check_groups.summary: New skills/workflows must be registered everywhere they are tracked; the dashboard snapshot must be fresh. This is the closed-loop / single-entry layer.

checks.detect: a .teams/skills/* skill is missing one of its .claude/.codex mirrors, OR is missing a .cursor/rules/xai-*.mdc mirror when it should work in Cursor, OR (if it is an operator entry-point skill) is absent from the curated dashboard '固定 skill' kpi note. NOTE: CLAUDE.md tracks skills by DIRECTORY (.teams/.claude/.codex/skills and Cursor rules are in the tracking contract), NOT a per-skill list; and the '固定 skill' kpi is a CURATED entry-point list — do NOT compare it against the raw .teams/skills directory count without checking entry-point intent
checks.owning_fix: self (.claude/.codex/.cursor mirror + curated kpi note; directory tracking already satisfies CLAUDE.md)

checks.detect: a workflow/agent/rule not registered across the tracked surfaces
dashboard snapshot commit != HEAD, or dirty-file count mismatch

apply_targets.note: When a record_drift finding is confirmed, write ALL relevant targets in one coherent pass so docs and dashboard stay aligned.

triggers.when: a feature reaches SHIPPED / after xai-feature-full-loop ship
triggers.wire: prompt to run audit; reuse sync-registry dev_log->SHIPPED hook
/loop 7d /xai-consistency-audit  OR macOS launchd/cron; report-only, no write contention with parallel agents
ship/RC pre-flight read-only audit (like xai-feature-dossier-sync before ship)

fields: Findings table (id | group | severity | evidence path:line | finding_type | owning_fix | action)
Apply plan (on confirm): coherent doc+dashboard edits
